cdWindowDim - Task Guides

  • Custom Message Windows: add a local extension to a custom or third-party message-window procedure.
  • Automatic Message Dimming: dim behind supported MESSAGE, STOP, and HALT dialogs without changing calls.
  • Automatic Window Dimming for Browses: let supported browse/update procedures dim their parent windows.
  • Manual Dim and Restore: place the dimming operation around a normal procedure or report call.
  • Dimming a Window Started with START: start a child on a separate thread and restore its parent when the child actually closes.
  • Runtime Dimming Controls: add Enable, Disable, Toggle, and Get Dimming Status commands, including saving a user preference.
  • Window Appearance: choose global or per-procedure colors and strength.
  • Temporarily Disable Dimming: turn off one operation or the whole template without removing settings.
  • Multi-DLL Applications: add the global extension only to APPs containing the affected windows.
  • Hand-Coded Integration: call the DLL functions directly.
  • DLL Function Reference: view the function prototypes and Clarion examples.
